changeinfo.changes:
Please note: save data saved in this new version will be unable to be used in the previous version of the title.

Main changes in Version 1.01.

  • New cross-over missions with "Soul Sacrifice" added: "Hell's Guard Dog" and "Dogs of War".
    These missions are available by visiting the multi-player mission center, and selecting Missions, then DLC.

The network version remains unchanged.

Main changes in Version 1.02.

  • Feature added allowing the upload of save data to the network. Select "Data Sharing" from the Main Menu. Uploaded save data can be imported into "Toukiden: Kiwami" for the "PlayStation 4" system.
